scripts.review: bash -o pipefail -c 'test -n "$SST_STAGE" && test "$SST_STAGE" != "production" && diff_file=$(mktemp) && trap '"'"'rm -f "$diff_file"'"'"' EXIT && sst diff --stage "$SST_STAGE" --print-logs > "$diff_file" && cat "$diff_file" >&2 && sed -E '"'"'/Permalink/d; s/ \([0-9.]+s\)$//'"'"' "$diff_file" | sed '"'"'/^[[:space:]]*$/d'"'"' | LC_ALL=C sort | sha256sum | cut -d " " -f 1'
scripts.deploy:first: bash -o pipefail -c 'test "$SST_FIRST_DEPLOY_APPROVAL" = "CREATE" && test -n "$SST_STAGE" && test "$SST_STAGE" != "production" && test "$SST_APPROVED_STAGE" = "$SST_STAGE" && test -n "$SST_APPROVED_MONTHLY_COST_USD" && test -n "$SST_APPROVED_GIT_REV" && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && test "$SST_APPROVED_GIT_REV" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" && pnpm run validate && diff_file=$(mktemp) && trap '"'"'rm -f "$diff_file"'"'"' EXIT && ! sst diff --stage "$SST_STAGE" > "$diff_file" 2>&1 && cat "$diff_file" >&2 && grep -q "Stage not found" "$diff_file" && sst deploy --stage "$SST_STAGE"'
scripts.deploy: bash -o pipefail -c 'test "$SST_DEPLOY_APPROVAL" = "DEPLOY" && test -n "$SST_STAGE" && test "$SST_STAGE" != "production" && test "$SST_APPROVED_STAGE" = "$SST_STAGE" && test -n "$SST_APPROVED_MONTHLY_COST_USD" && test -n "$SST_APPROVED_DIFF_SHA256" && pnpm run validate && diff_file=$(mktemp) && trap '"'"'rm -f "$diff_file"'"'"' EXIT && sst diff --stage "$SST_STAGE" > "$diff_file" && cat "$diff_file" >&2 && current_diff_sha256=$(sed -E '"'"'/Permalink/d; s/ \([0-9.]+s\)$//'"'"' "$diff_file" | sed '"'"'/^[[:space:]]*$/d'"'"' | LC_ALL=C sort | sha256sum | cut -d " " -f 1) && test "$SST_APPROVED_DIFF_SHA256" = "$current_diff_sha256" && sst deploy --stage "$SST_STAGE"'
